Info

Implementation of IScaraLexer converting SCARA DSL source text into atomic tokens.

class scaralang.core.service.parser.lexer.scara_lexer.ScaraLexer[source]¶

Bases: object

Concrete lexer implementation converting SCARA DSL text into stream of tokens.

It defines:

attributes:
_TOKEN_REGEX - Compiled regular expression matching DSL lexical entities.
_PATTERN_TO_TOKEN_TYPE - Mapping of pattern kinds to token types.
name - Identifier name of the lexer.
methods:
tokenize - Tokenizes raw source code into an immutable tuple of lexical tokens.
_PATTERN_TO_TOKEN_TYPE: ClassVar[Mapping[LexerPatternKind, ScaraTokenType]] = {LexerPatternKind.COMMA: ScaraTokenType.COMMA, LexerPatternKind.EQUALS: ScaraTokenType.EQUALS, LexerPatternKind.IDENTIFIER: ScaraTokenType.IDENTIFIER, LexerPatternKind.LPAREN: ScaraTokenType.LPAREN, LexerPatternKind.NUMBER: ScaraTokenType.NUMBER, LexerPatternKind.RPAREN: ScaraTokenType.RPAREN, LexerPatternKind.STRING: ScaraTokenType.STRING}¶
_TOKEN_REGEX: ClassVar[Pattern[str]] = re.compile('(?P<COMMENT>[#;].*$)|(?P<NUMBER>[-+]?(?:\\d*\\.\\d+|\\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\\d+)?)|(?P<STRING>"(?:\\\\.|[^"\\\\])*"|\\\'(?:\\\\.|[^\\\'\\\\])*\\\')|(?P<EQUALS>=)|(?P<COMMA>,)|(?P<LPAREN>\\()|(?P<RPAREN>\\))¶
property name: str¶

Gets the lexer identifier name.

Returns:

Lexer name string.

tokenize(*, source: str) → tuple[ScaraToken, ...][source]¶

Tokenizes source text into a tuple of ScaraToken instances.

Parameters:

source – Raw source code string.

Returns:

Immutable tuple of ScaraToken tokens.

Exceptions:

ScaraSyntaxError if an illegal/unrecognized character is encountered.
